# Provenance for medians.csv / raw/{flat,bits}_{A..E}.log (the CANONICAL rows).
# Generated by run.sh: ONE implementation per process (Phase-2 convention),
# 5 rounds per (impl, workload), flat/bits alternating which goes first across
# rounds. Each process does best-of-3 timed reps of the workload's effective
# update count at scale 1M.
#
# EFFECTIVE per-timed-block update count at scale 1M (the number actually
# replayed by the timed apply loop for each row):
#   A = 2000000   B = 500000   C = 2000000   D = 2000000   E = 2000000
# B uses 500000 (not 2M) ONLY to bound wall time: workload B's off-clock stream
# generation degenerates at near-full density (~31 s per 2M-update process,
# implementation-neutral, untimed). The B flat-vs-bits delta is measured on
# identical streams at identical updates. See run.sh for the reasoning.
#
# Per-process invocation inside run.sh (repeated for 5 rounds, alternating
# impl order):
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench flat A 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench flat B 1000000 updates=500000  reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench flat C 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench flat D 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench flat E 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench bits A 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench bits B 1000000 updates=500000  reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench bits C 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench bits D 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench bits E 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# flat.csv / bits.csv are SEPARATE single-sample reproductions of the frozen
# Phase-2 references (flat_A_1M=4.327, flat_C_1M=5.912). Those rows used 2M
# updates for EVERY workload including B (a 2M B process takes ~31 s of stream
# generation but finishes):
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench flat B 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
./build/orderbook_bitmap_bench bits B 1000000 updates=2000000 reps=3
# (The A/C/D/E rows in flat.csv / bits.csv used the same 2M count as above.)
#
# inproc.csv (drift-free flat-vs-bits delta, both impls in one process) used
# --inproc=24 blocks for A/C/D/E at 2M and --inproc=32 blocks for B at 500k;
# see inproc_command.txt.
